name: Family
summary: Expo-out at one second for anything that moves, with a 0.1s to 0.2s floor for fills, shadows and links.

tiers.label: panels easing on hover (selector is unnamed: div > div)

honestyNote: Family's CSS is styled-components injected into the page, so there were no stylesheet files; the inline sheets were read instead. 123 links compute transition: all (0.2s ease-out), from two `a` rules.
notes: The 1s curve is cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), the common stand-in for expo-out. It's the same curve the house statement tier uses.
Avatars carry a 0.22s expo-out at rest but switch to a 0.18s ease while hovered, so the way in and the way out differ.
Selectors are styled-components hashes; the panel selector is literally div > div.

fromNotes.label: statement curve (expo-out)
fromNotes.text: On 56 elements. Live on 2026-10-17: the same, on 56 elements.

fromNotes.label: utility floor
fromNotes.text: ease-out at 0.2s on 105 elements, ease at 0.1s on 49, ease-in-out at 0.1s on 44.
